query IntrospectionQuery {
              __schema {
        
                queryType { name }
                mutationType { name }
                subscriptionType { name }
                types {
                  ...FullType
                }
                directives {
                  name
                  description
        
                  locations
                  args {
                    ...InputValue
                  }
                }
              }
            }
        
            fragment FullType on __Type {
              kind
              name
              description
        
              fields(includeDeprecated: true) {
                name
                description
                args {
                  ...InputValue
                }
                type {
                  ...TypeRef
                }
                isDeprecated
                deprecationReason
              }
              inputFields {
                ...InputValue
